title: Dead Reckoning Outbox Entry
description: A deferred side effect: the tool, its arguments, the idempotency key, the preconditions and observed values that justified it, and its lifecycle state. Entries are mutable (state advances); every state change also emits an OUTBOX_STATE record so the history is immutable.

node_id.description: The node that holds execution rights. Peers may hold a replica for visibility.

idempotency_key.description: Unique per node; across nodes, the lower created_hlc wins execution rights.

decision_id.description: The FINAL (or MODEL_TURN) record whose reasoning produced this intent. Used to trace conflicts and reviews to held entries.

deferral_record_id.description: The DEFERRAL record created atomically with this entry.

observed_value.description: Value seen when the decision was made.

observed_source.description: Where the observed value came from.

current_value.description: Value seen at the most recent drain attempt. Absent until drained.

holds.description: Result of the most recent drain check. Null until drained.

reason.description: Which rule required it: tool policy, identity state, or mode. IDENTITY_INSUFFICIENT means the authority table refused it at drain.

expires_at.description: Wall time; compared using the node's best current time. If time trust is UNTRUSTED, expiry is evaluated conservatively (treated as expired if either clock says so).

result_record_id.description: TOOL_RESULT record from execution, when DONE.

superseded_by.description: Peer outbox entry id, when SUPERSEDED_BY_PEER.

history.description: Ordered list of OUTBOX_STATE record ids. The authoritative history lives in those records; this is an index.

reason.description: Machine-readable: CREATED, APPROVAL_REQUIRED, APPROVED, REJECTED, PRECONDITIONS_HOLD, PRECONDITION_FAILED, EXECUTED, EXEC_ERROR, EXPIRED, DUPLICATE_REJECTED, HELD_FOR_CONFLICT, RELEASED_BY_RESOLUTION, CANCELLED_BY_RESOLUTION, CANCELLED_BY_REDECISION, SUPERSEDED_BY_PEER, UNKNOWN_EXECUTION_STATE
